description: Get Caffeinated, Get Paid. This fast growing Canadian coffee company is looking for more coffee junkies to caffeinate. This partnership may be what you are looking for with FREE monthly coffee subscriptions and 12% commissions on referrals, it's a no brainer. You will see success with our bold branding and approachable angles. Promote delicious coffee, kick ass merch and branded coffee accessories easily on your social media, email list, blog, and to your coffee junkie friends. Join our epic Fueled By Rampage team TODAY!
term_and_condition:
Welcome to Rampage Coffee Co.! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.


These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.


By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.


1. Approval or Rejection of  Registration or Commissions


We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. 


We also reserve the right to withhold or reject commissions if we determine, in our sole discretion, that the affiliate has violated these terms or engaged in activities inconsistent with the intent of the program.



You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration or  your Commissions.


2. Affiliate Representation & Platform Requirements


Affiliates are required to provide at least one active social media platform or streaming platform. Affiliates represent our brand when promoting Rampage Coffee Co. Any website, social media profile, streaming channel, or other platform used for promotion must be directly connected to the affiliate and clearly represent the affiliate’s identity or brand.


Accounts or platforms that appear misleading, fraudulent, suspicious, or unrelated to the affiliate’s stated identity may result in application rejection, suspension, or termination of the affiliate account, as well as forfeiture of any unpaid commissions. We reserve the right to make this determination at our sole discretion.


3. Affiliate Links and Coupon


Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.


Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both clicks on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.


Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.



Affiliate Coupon Code Requirements


All custom affiliate coupon codes must be unique, not easily guessed, and specific to the affiliate. Generic codes (e.g., “DISCOUNT,” “SALE,” or simple numeric sequences such as “12345”) are not permitted. If numeric, codes must be a minimum of 8 numbers. Codes must be used only for legitimate affiliate tracking purposes. Any orders placed using non-compliant or generic codes will not qualify for commissions.


4. Commissions and payment


You will earn a commission on orders from new customers you refer when they shop through your affiliate link or use your coupon code. You will not earn a commission on orders from our existing customers. Customers who place an order using your link or code will receive a 10% discount on their order. Coupon codes are not valid during large sales. Terms are subject to change. Commission is calculated based on commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).


For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.



Affiliate commissions are only eligible for payout once the affiliate’s available commission balance reaches a minimum of $25 CAD. Commission balances below this threshold will remain pending until the minimum payout amount is met.


Once the minimum threshold is reached, commissions may be paid out according to the affiliate’s selected payout method, provided all account and payment details are complete and up to date.


Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.



Commissions must be paid out within 12 months of the date they are earned. Any commissions not paid out within this 12-month period — including due to the affiliate’s failure to select or maintain a valid payout method — will be forfeited and removed from the affiliate account.


We are unable to issue payouts for accounts without a selected payout method. It is the affiliate’s responsibility to ensure their payment details are accurate and up to date.


We reserve the right to modify payout thresholds, payout methods, and commission policies at any time, with notice provided via the affiliate dashboard or email.


5. Marketing tool


We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.


6. Network


If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.


To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.


7. Cookie


We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.


If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.


Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).


8. Prohibited Promotional Tactics – Brand Bidding & Paid Ad Abuse


The following activity is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate termination from the program without payout of outstanding commissions:


• Bidding on the merchant’s brand name or misspellings in Google Ads, Bing Ads, or any other PPC advertising platform.

• Using the merchant’s website URL (e.g., www.rampagecoffee.com) as a display URL or destination in paid advertisements.

• Running paid advertisements that redirect traffic from customers already intending to visit the merchant’s website directly.

• Any activity that hijacks or intercepts brand-driven organic or paid traffic for the purpose of triggering affiliate attribution.


These tactics undermine the intent of our affiliate program, which is to reward affiliates for genuinely referring new customers through their own promotional efforts.


Violation of this policy will result in immediate account termination and forfeiture of any unpaid commissions.


9. Removal from Referral Program


If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: info@rampagecoffee.com.


Go forward and refer!


We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.


We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to info@rampagecoffee.com for support.
